claim: Tree-twin re-anchor (correct fix after rewrite): build twin index (git log main --format='%H %T'), find deepest ancestor with same %T. Case A (exact tip twin): push --force-with-lease=old:old origin twin:branch. Case B (no tip twin): git rebase --onto twin base. Verify merge-base HEAD origin/main == twin SHA. Never flatten branches to main; re-anchor moves ref only, does not merge content.
